reasons: The cited Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on every material term: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, and term plus one year.

Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request plus additional customer-favorable mechanics (reputable insurers, primary coverage, cancellation notice, non-limitation of liability), so no redline is warranted.
Consistent with a compliant finding: no redline was rendered and no counterparty comment proposed; the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
The 'to the extent available from its insurer' qualifier on cancellation notice is correctly treated as a minor sub-element noted in the rationale rather than a deviation.
